_meta.description: Source registry for Phase 7B.6 climatisation market research. All sources collected before reviewing legacy FIXEO prices. No source may be used in reference calculations without complete metadata.

sources.methodology_summary: Editorial price guide from a Moroccan home-services marketplace. Provides per-intervention price ranges with scope commentary. Platform also aggregates artisan profiles with displayed rates. Evidence of active listings in clim category. No declared statistical sample.
sources.parts_policy: PARTS_EXTRA_UNLESS_STATED — editorial position that labour and travel included, parts always separate
sources.limitations: No declared sample size. Some prices may reflect listing aspirations rather than transaction data. Editorial content; duplication risk with other Moroccan guides that copy each other.

sources.methodology_summary: Live classified listings from artisans and small businesses advertising clim services. Prices reflect asking prices, not necessarily transaction prices. High geographic spread. Useful for floor/ceiling estimates. Individual listings vary widely in scope definition.
sources.limitations: Asking prices not transaction prices. Scope rarely defined in listings. Geographic mixing. Strong downward bias from informal artisans under-declaring scope. Duplication risk if same artisan lists multiple ads.
sources.notes: Useful for floor detection and geographic spread. Not for anchor derivation alone.

sources.methodology_summary: E-commerce platform. Used ONLY for hardware/parts price context: condensateurs, modules PCB, refrigerants, copper fittings sold separately. NOT used for labour pricing.
sources.limitations: Parts prices only. Not representative of artisan wholesale cost. Retail markup over artisan procurement. Cannot be used for labour pricing.

sources.methodology_summary: Moroccan on-demand home services platform. Published standardized price grid for clim services with clear scope definitions per service. Higher confidence than classifieds because platform sets the pricing frame. Urban bias towards Casablanca.
sources.parts_policy: LABOUR_FIXED_PARTS_SEPARATE — platform explicitly separates labour from refrigerant cost
sources.limitations: Urban bias. Platform may set aspirational prices to attract clients. Some scope definitions still vague on copper included/excluded.

sources.methodology_summary: Editorial home-services price guide from a Moroccan real estate and home content publisher. Covers installation, maintenance and repair ranges. No declared methodology or sample. Likely editorially aggregated.
sources.limitations: No methodology declared. Probable editorial aggregation. May copy other Moroccan guides. Copper length included in installation not always specified.

sources.publisher: Moroccan BTP / construction cost indices (DEPF / Ministère de l'Equipement)
sources.methodology_summary: Official Moroccan government construction and equipment labour cost schedule (bordereau de prix). Covers technician day rates and installation forfaits for HVAC and climatisation in public/commercial contracts. More relevant to commercial installation than residential repair, but provides labour floor benchmarks.
sources.limitations: Commercial/public sector orientation. Day rates not directly comparable to residential flat-rate interventions. Not disaggregated by refrigerant type.
sources.notes: Used for artisan economic floor validation, not market anchor.

sources.publisher: Facebook Marketplace Morocco / informal artisan communities
sources.methodology_summary: Informal price signals from Facebook marketplace listings and Moroccan artisan WhatsApp/Facebook groups. Extreme variability. Strong downward bias as informal workers undercut formal platforms. Useful only for identifying absolute floor prices and detecting market practices.

price_ranges_captured.recharge_gaz_informelle: 100–300 MAD (blind refill, no vacuum, no leak check)

sources.limitations: No verification. Widespread unsafe practice of blind recharges without leak diagnosis. Scope undisclosed. Cannot be used for market anchor. Useful only for identifying unsafe market practices and absolute floor.
sources.unsafe_practice_flag: BLIND_RECHARGE_DOCUMENTED — informal market regularly offers recharge without vacuum, without leak test, without refrigerant type verification

sources.publisher: Moroccan HVAC contractor websites (aggregate of publicly published price grids)
sources.methodology_summary: Published price grids from Moroccan HVAC installation and maintenance companies. More scope-defined than classifieds. Oriented towards residential split AC (mono and multi). Prices tend to be mid-to-high market as formal companies compete on quality, not just price.
sources.parts_policy: LABOUR_FIXED_PARTS_ALWAYS_SEPARATE — all contractor sites separate labour from part cost
sources.limitations: Urban bias. Companies may display aspirational prices. Multi-company aggregate introduces variance. Some quoted prices are 'à partir de' (starting from).

sources.methodology_summary: Moroccan renovation cost editorial site. Covers installation pricing with scope detail. Cross-references French renovation guides methodology without specific Moroccan sample declaration. Useful for installation scope benchmark.
sources.limitations: No sample size. Possibly adapted from French sources. Installation scope details vary. Not disaggregated by BTU range.

sources.publisher: Moroccan consumer forum / Marocannonces / community threads
sources.methodology_summary: Consumer experience reports from Moroccan forums and online communities. Real transaction prices reported anecdotally. High variability. Useful for cross-checking outlier prices and detecting consumer complaints about overpricing.
sources.limitations: Anecdotal. Scope undefined. Selection bias (users report extreme prices — both too cheap and too expensive). Cannot anchor market reference.

sources.methodology_summary: FIXEO internal estimation engine. Category-level price buckets (simple/medium/heavy/urgent) for climatisation. Not service-level granularity. Origin of values unknown — no external source documentation. Must not be used to calibrate market truth.
sources.limitations: Category-level only. No service granularity. No source documentation. T0 — never use for market calibration.

sources.methodology_summary: FIXEO hero estimation v2. Identical category structure to v1. Climatisation bucket identical: simple 200–400, medium 300–700, heavy 500–1200, urgent 350–750. No service-level granularity. T0.
sources.limitations: Identical to T01. Likely copy of same internal table. T0 — never use for market calibration.

sources.methodology_summary: FIXEO marocain pricing file. Single category bucket for climatisation: 200–900 MAD range with label 'À partir de 200 MAD'. Extremely coarse. No service breakdown. T0.
sources.limitations: Single range for entire métier. Useless for service-level calibration. T0 — never use for market calibration.

sources.methodology_summary: FIXEO artisan profile price map. Four service-level entries for climatisation with MAD ranges: Panne 200–500, Entretien 200–350, Installation 500–900, Réparation 250–600. More granular than estimation engines but still vague (e.g. 'installation 500–900' without scope definition).
sources.limitations: Four broad buckets only. No refrigerant type, no BTU range, no copper length scope. T0 — never use for market calibration.
